description: Heating moves the material towards the responsive liquid state.
The main window in which local magnetic stimulus can reorganise multiple properties.
The same stimulus produces several direct, secondary, delayed and residual responses.
Gravity is continuously present but becomes predominant only when magnetic relations weaken.
Accumulation carries the consequences of earlier stimulation into later material states.
Solidification closes some relationships while preserving selected material outcomes.
The material retains legacies from prior interactions even when earlier associations are no longer active.
